verdict.line: You lose if you auto-attack into an up W (Riposte) or open with R before pulling her in; you win if you land E (Apprehend) first and stack Hemorrhage before she resets with Q (Lunge).

brief.thesis: Both of you win extended stick-fights, so this comes down to sequencing: Fiora's W (Riposte) parries your next basic attack and buffs her AD, and her passive Duelist heals her on every hit she lands, so a sloppy all-in just feeds her healing. Darius' answer is to pull first with E (Apprehend) — landing the hook applies Hemorrhage and lets you stack Q and W without ever feeding her a parriable auto. Measured data backs an even lane (47.1% over 155 games) with the solo-kill edge on your side, which matches the read: if you initiate correctly you out-duel her, if you don't she out-sustains you.

theirWindow.when: Her E (Burst of Speed) is active
theirWindow.what: She gains bonus attack speed and every landed hit or Lunge speeds her up further, so she can chain autos into you and then kite or reposition faster than you can follow. Don't chase once she's disengaging under Burst of Speed — you'll just eat free autos while she resets space.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Riposte) was just used or is on cooldown (10/9/8/7/6s)
yourWindow.what: Riposte only blocks your next basic attack, so once it's down you can freely auto and land E (Apprehend) without fear of the parry buffing her AD. Pull with E, land Q (Decimate) for the blade-side heal, then W (Crippling Strike) to lock her in range before finishing.

start.why: 83.5% pick rate and the highest win rate start (49% over 157 games) — the lifesteal offsets the poke you eat closing distance before E is up.

boots.why: 83.8% pick rate; Fiora's damage is entirely auto-attack and Lunge-based, so the flat physical mitigation blunts her extended trades better than the alternative.

core.why: Active haste closes the gap on her Q (Lunge) resets and lets you actually land E instead of watching her kite away.
Move speed stacking keeps you attached through her Burst of Speed windows; part of the highest-win-rate build path (66.7% over 12 games).
Bleed-out damage reduction directly counters her healing race — she wins prolonged fights on raw sustain, this closes that gap.

situational.when: she is winning extended duels off her passive healing and you need the shield to survive to your own R
her team adds magic damage on top of her physical pressure and you need the tenacity and move speed to stay on her

runes.keystoneWhy: This is a stick-fight matchup decided by extended trades — Conqueror's adaptive force stacking rewards you for staying in range through her Duelist healing instead of trying to burst and reset.

summoners.why: 60.6% pick rate at 51.8% win — Ghost is what actually lets you stay attached through her Q (Lunge) resets and E (Burst of Speed) kiting, which Flash alone can't solve in a matchup built around sticking.

playing.title: Never auto into an up W
playing.detail: Riposte parries your next basic attack and buffs her AD on top of the reflected damage. If her W is up, engage with E (Apprehend) or Q (Decimate) instead of an auto to avoid feeding the parry.

playing.title: Pull before you R
playing.detail: Landing E (Apprehend) first means Hemorrhage is already stacking and her W is more likely spent, so your Noxian Guillotine finishes clean instead of risking a blocked engage.

playing.title: Track her Q charge
playing.detail: Lunge (16/14/12/10/8s CD) can be used twice within a couple seconds at no cost. If she's already thrown the first dash, the second is coming immediately — don't waste your E dodging the first one.

playing.title: Stack Hemorrhage before committing R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks, so land Q's blade edge and a W (Crippling Strike) auto first — a 5-stack R is a completely different threshold than a 1-stack R.

playing.title: Punish her Q cooldown windows
playing.detail: Her only gap-closer is Q (Lunge). Between 8-16s of Q cooldown (scales by rank) she has no way to disengage your E pull — this is when your all-ins land cleanest.

playing.title: Don't overextend into her E burst
playing.detail: Burst of Speed increases her attack speed and grants move speed on every landed hit or Lunge, and killing a champion refreshes it. If you're low, disengage early rather than trading — she out-scales a drawn-out duel once it's active.

playing.title: Use Youmuu's active to force the engage
playing.detail: Her kit has no hard CC to punish your approach, only the W parry. Youmuu's Ghostblade haste closes distance fast enough that she can't kite you down with Q resets before your E is in range.

brief.patchCaveat: Item paths, runes, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.18.1); the timing reads, power spikes, and execution notes are my own tactical analysis built on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Fiora’s (P) when fighting her. Do not let her block your ultimate with her (W) by using [E] - [R] combo instead.
